description: Encode edge, plain text: a single user turn crosses canonical chat.request -> anthropic/messages losslessly — the text part becomes a `text` content block and `config.max_output_tokens` renames to the wire's REQUIRED `max_tokens` (a rename on the contract, not re-reported per call; the fixture supplies it so no injection shift fires). Synthetic, wire-accurate, hand-authored against the MessagesRequest / MessageParam / TextBlockParam structs (ocai-anthropic messages/wire.py). The wire `model` member is NOT edge output: the canonical request carries no model (WU-05a, architecture §3.4) and the harness injects the bound resource via the codec's bind_resource seam, below the edge — ports must do the same before comparing.
